\section*{Question 5}

A cubic polynomial function \(f\) is defined by
\[
f(x)=4 x^{3}+a x^{2}+b x+k
\]
where \(a, b\), and \(k\) are constants. The function \(f\) has a local minimum at \(x=-1\), and the graph of \(f\) has a point of inflection at \(x=-2\).
\begin{itemize}
\item[(a)] Find the values of \(a\) and \(b\).
\item[(b)] If \(\int_{0}^{1} f(x) d x=32\), what is the value of \(k\) ?
\item[(a)]
\[
\begin{aligned}
& f^{\prime}(x)=12 x^{2}+2 a x+b \\
& f^{\prime \prime}(x)=24 x+2 a \\
& f^{\prime}(-1)=12-2 a+b=0 \\
& f^{\prime \prime}(-2)=-48+2 a=0
\end{aligned}
\]
\[
\begin{aligned}
& a=24 \\
& b=-12+2 a=36
\end{aligned}
\]
\item[(b)]
\[
\begin{aligned}
& \int_{0}^{1}\left(4 x^{3}+24 x^{2}+36 x+k\right) d x \\
& =x^{4}+8 x^{3}+18 x^{2}+\left.k x\right|_{x=0} ^{x=1}=27+k \\
& 27+k=32 \\
& k=5
\end{aligned}
\]
\end{itemize}
